messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "stop taking it and call your doctor if a skin condition you are treating gets worse"
set: ["stop taking it and call your doctor if a skin condition you are treating gets worse", "stop taking it and call your doctor if you develop a rash", "call your doctor if your anxiety does not improve or if it gets worse", "call your doctor if condition does not improve or gets worse while using this medicine", "call healthcare provider if pain gets worse", "stop taking it and call your doctor if you have any other sign of an allergic reaction", "stop taking and call doctor right away", "stop taking and call doctor at once if symptoms occur", "stop using and call doctor at once if any skin rash", "call doctor if symptoms get worse", "tell your doctor if you are breast-feeding a baby", "tell your doctor if you have a muscle weakness condition", "change in mental health even if you are taking it to treat a different type of condition", "stop taking if pregnant and call healthcare provider immediately", "stop taking and tell doctor immediately if pregnant", "call your doctor if you experience agitation"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "stop taking it and call your doctor if a skin condition you are treating gets worse",
    "stop taking it and call your doctor if you have any other sign of an allergic reaction",
    "stop taking and call doctor right away",
    "stop taking and call doctor at once if symptoms occur",
    "stop using and call doctor at once if any skin rash",
    "call doctor if symptoms get worse"
  ],
  "alias": "stop taking it and call your doctor if a skin condition you are treating gets worse"
}
